ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 65% low-intensity (black) central region vs 35% high-intensity (white) lateral regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity central zone extending from the notch to the mid-lobe; lateral lobes are high-intensity with discrete low-intensity circular clusters (mottling) scattered throughout the trailing margin.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a pixel-calculated vertex angle of approximately 50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Fine, high-frequency serrations along the medial trailing edges; transitioning to high-amplitude, irregular jagged protrusions at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex mid-lobe trajectory with a slight terminal upward recurve at the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-intensity, irregular circular pixel clusters (barnacle colonization) localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-contrast white linear pixel streaks (rake marks) oriented diagonally across the low-intensity central pigmentation zones.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant biofouling/barnacle clusters at the lobe tips and distinct linear rake marks on the ventral surface.
